column1: Raw data used for analyses in Gotelli, N.J., and A.M. Ellison. 2006. Food-web models predict species abundance in response to habitat change. PLoS Biology 44(10): e324. DOI: 10.1371/journal.pbio.0040324
Treatment: Leaf manipulations: A = Control; B = Trophic Removal; C = Habitat Expansion; D = Habitat Expansion & Trophic Removal; E = Habitat Contraction & Trophic Removal.
Leaf Age: X = Previous year?s leaf; A = First leaf; B = Second leaf.
Plant ID: Unique identification number for each plant assigned to an experimental treatment.
Leaf Volume: Average habitat volume (ml) for each leaf during the experiment.
Species (Protozoa ? Wyeomyia): Average abundance of individual taxa and prey measured in the experiment. Protozoa data were log2(x + 1) transformed.
